env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Copilot can research a repository, create an implementation plan, and make code changes on a branch.
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: paper About GitHub Copilot cloud agent (GitHub Docs)
env_context_strategy.note: Inferred from prose; the docs also mention enhancing repository knowledge (custom instructions), which is not shown in detail here. Single value per schema.

observation_format.evidence_quote: every step happening in a commit and being viewable in logs
observation_format.evidence_locator: paper Benefits over traditional AI workflows
observation_format.note: Playwright MCP enabled by default could yield screenshots; not stated.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The GitHub MCP server and Playwright MCP server are enabled by default for both features.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers: MCP servers allow you to give Copilot access to different data sources and tools.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Copilot can research a repository, create an implementation plan, and make code changes on a branch.
loop_primitives.note: plan_execute from documented research/plan/implement flow; react inferred from tool-using loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: you can also use Copilot cloud agent to research a repository and create a plan before any code is written
planning_granularity.note: Plan is a reviewable artifact presented before code changes.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Copilot can only work on one branch at a time and can open exactly one pull request to address each task it is assigned.
multi_agent_topology.note: Custom agents are alternative specialized configurations, not concurrent agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Copilot cannot make changes across multiple repositories in one run.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: You can review the diff, iterate, and create a pull request when you're ready.
human_in_loop.note: Human reviews plan/diff and decides to open the PR; no per-action approval documented.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Copilot Memory (public preview) ... allows Copilot to store useful details it has worked out for itself about a repository
long_term_memory.evidence_locator: paper Enhancing Copilot cloud agent's knowledge of a repository
long_term_memory.note: Skills: "Skills allow you to enhance the ability of Copilot to perform specialized tasks with instructions, scripts, and resources." Memory is opt-in preview.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: If a task exceeds this limit, the session will time out and stop.
state_persistence.note: No resume of a timed-out session documented.

self_verification.evidence_quote: where it can explore your code, make changes, execute automated tests and linters and more
self_verification.evidence_locator: paper Overview of Copilot cloud agent

rollback.evidence_quote: Copilot automates branch creation, commit message writing, and pushing.
rollback.evidence_locator: paper Benefits over traditional AI workflows
rollback.note: Work is isolated on a branch; explicit rollback tooling not documented.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Each Copilot cloud agent session has a maximum execution time of 59 minutes.
termination_condition.note: Closest values; the documented hard limit is wall-clock time (see F3), not steps. Agent finishing its task and opening a PR is the model-declared end.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Copilot cloud agent uses GitHub Actions minutes and AI credits. The AI credits consumed depend on the model used and the number of tokens processed during the session.
cost_controls.evidence_locator: paper Copilot cloud agent usage costs
cost_controls.note: Credit/minute allowances act as budget; model selection is user-chosen, not automatic routing.

timeouts.evidence_quote: You can configure a shorter timeout using the timeout-minutes setting in your copilot-setup-steps.yml file.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Copilot cloud agent has access to its own ephemeral development environment, powered by GitHub Actions
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: paper Overview of Copilot cloud agent
execution_isolation.note: Cloud-hosted GitHub Actions runner; container/VM detail not specified.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Copilot can only make changes in the repository specified when you start a task.
filesystem_access.note: Scoped relative to the ephemeral Actions environment / single repository.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Copilot cloud agent can work independently in the background to complete tasks
permission_model.evidence_locator: paper Overview of Copilot cloud agent
permission_model.note: No per-action authorisation documented; hooks could add validation.

tracing.evidence_quote: with every step happening in a commit and being viewable in logs
tracing.evidence_locator: paper Benefits over traditional AI workflows

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Enterprise administrators and organization owners can use Copilot usage metrics to analyze pull request outcomes
eval_hooks.evidence_locator: paper Measuring pull request outcomes for Copilot cloud agent
eval_hooks.note: Usage metrics, not benchmark evaluation hooks; closed source so no repo to inspect.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Hooks allow you to execute custom shell commands at key points during agent execution, enabling you to add validation, logging, security scanning, or workflow automation.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
Fix bugs

Implement incremental new features

Improve test coverage
target_domain.evidence_locator: paper Overview of Copilot cloud agent

open_source.evidence_quote: Copilot cloud agent is available for all paid Copilot plans.
open_source.evidence_locator: paper Who can use this feature?
open_source.note: Proprietary hosted GitHub product; no source repository.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Depending on how you start your Copilot cloud agent task, you may be able to select the model used by Copilot cloud agent.
model_agnostic.evidence_locator: paper AI models for Copilot cloud agent
model_agnostic.note: Model choice limited to GitHub-offered models; not arbitrary provider keys.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: About GitHub Copilot cloud agent - GitHub Docs
primary_artifact.note: Coded from vendor documentation; no repo or academic paper.
